lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the branchial region, with higher density observed between the primary and secondary carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a rectangular lattice across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; each displays a distinct vertical gradient characterized by high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.
